summary: On paper San Francisco has the edge (San Francisco ranks 3rd in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.12), while Arizona's best counter is to run it in short yardage (Arizona ranks 3rd in short-yardage run success, 49%). The model favors San Francisco at 63%, mostly on starting QB (2.4 pts) and home field (1.7 pts).

Arizona's defense ranks 15th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.08 allowed). San Francisco ranks 3rd (+0.12).

SF.detail: San Francisco's defense ranks 5th in short-yardage run success (65% allowed). Arizona ranks 3rd (49%).
San Francisco ranks 3rd in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.12). Arizona's defense ranks 15th (+0.08 allowed).
